speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand the issue with your right ring finger, can you describe exactly when the swelling and pain started and if there was any recent injury or trauma? Also, have you noticed any changes in color, warmth, or drainage from the finger?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you hear or feel a "pop" at the moment of injury, and have you noticed any deformity or difficulty bending the finger since then? I would like to examine the range of motion and stability of the joint.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience pain when you passively attempt to bend the tip of your finger toward your palm, and do you feel a bump or gap at the base of the fingernail? I need to assess if the tendon has been avulsed from the bone.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant medical history. Social history: Student and active in sports, particularly football. Non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.

speaker: Doctor
text: I suspect a mallet finger injury based on your description. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray Right Ring Finger.
